messages:
maya (product): Heads-up — multiple customers on Dedicated and Hosted complaining that the per-model throughput sparklines in Console have gone flat (zero) since yesterday's metrics key rotation. They show model rows but the graph is a flat line. Screenshots incoming.

omar (support): Which customers? any correlation to region/model type? Are API requests still succeeding?

maya (product): Two mid-market tenants (acme-inc, brightapps) in us-west-2 and eu-central. Their API traffic is normal, no increase in 5xx. This looks purely analytics/metrics.

metrics-bot: alert: console.panel.per_model_throughput detected missing series for labels: model_name for 7 series in us-west-2 at 2025-11-03T14:02:00Z

omar (support): I pulled one example from acme-inc: their console panel query returns no time series for the per-model QPS metric after the key change. Repro steps I used:
1) Open Console -> Models -> Per-model throughput
2) Observe sparkline = flatline
3) Click "Inspect" -> Raw query shows: count by(model) (redwood_model_qps{org="acme-inc"}) -> returns 0 series

jen (sre): Can you paste the raw output of the Prometheus scrape or a metrics endpoint? Also, which rotation was applied (namespace -> metric_key swap? exporter label change?)

omar (support): From the exporter:
```
$ curl -s http://prom-exporter.acme.svc.cluster.local:9100/metrics | grep redwood_model_qps
# HELP redwood_model_qps Queries per second per model
# TYPE redwood_model_qps gauge
redwood_model_qps{model="gpt-small",region="us-west-2"} 0
redwood_model_qps{model="gpt-medium",region="us-west-2"} 0
```
Note labels are `model` instead of Console expecting `model_name`, and some panels query by `model_name`.

alex (devex): That mismatched label is exactly it — Console dashboards were updated last week to use `model_name` as the canonical label. The metric-key rotation on the exporter replaced label `model_name` with `model` for consistency. Dashboards weren't made tolerant to both. Workaround: use label_replace or regex in the Grafana/Console panel until a compatibility shim is added. Example PromQL fallback: 
```
count by(model_name) (
  redwood_model_qps or
  label_replace(redwood_model_qps, "model_name", "$1", "model", "(.*)")
)
```

eli (eng-platform): Confirmed — exporter relabeling PR swapped `model_name` -> `model` globally to align with other services. We missed updating Console's panel queries and the metrics adapter mapping. Two options:
- quick: patch Console dashboard queries to use label_replace fallback (low risk, short)
- proper: update metrics-adapter to synthesize `model_name` from `model` for 7 days post-rotation and release a compatibility build, then revert dashboards

jen (sre): I can deploy a hotfix to Console dashboards (panel-level) for the impacted orgs to restore visibility now. Before doing that, let's verify PromQL across clusters: run `count by(model_name) (redwood_model_qps)` and the fallback `count by(model_name) (label_replace(...))` to ensure fallback returns series.

omar (support): Ran quick checks for acme-inc and brightapps — fallback returns expected series. Verified panels show restored sparklines when I paste adjusted query.

maya (product): Good. Customers are sensitive to analytics regression. Can we estimate timeframe for the proper fix? Also want a postmortem note to customers explaining we introduced a metrics-label change and the Console didn't tolerate it.

eli (eng-platform): ETA: hotfix dashboards in <1h (jen will handle), compatibility shim in metrics-adapter and a canary release in ~4-6h, full rollout in 24h after monitoring. I'll open an internal ticket and tag @eng-platform. We'll add a temporary mapping: if `model` exists and `model_name` doesn't, copy it.

alex (devex): I'll prepare the customer-facing blurb: root cause = metrics exporter label change (`model_name` -> `model`) + Console dashboards not using label-fallback. Mitigation = temporary dashboard patch + compatibility shim.

jen (sre): Action items:
- [ ] patch Console panels with label_replace fallback (this afternoon)
- [ ] roll metrics-adapter compatibility shim to canary cluster
- [ ] monitor per-model panel alerts and open incident if graphs still silent after patch

omar (support): I'll message affected customers with ETA and workaround steps (paste label_replace snippet) and set expectation for full fix.

maya (product): Thanks. Please add timeline to the internal ticket and ping me when dashboards are patched. :white_check_mark:

eli (eng-platform): Created ENG-PLAT-4221 and assigned to me + jen + alex. Linking logs and the exporter PR that introduced the label rename.

metrics-bot: incident update: ENG-PLAT-4221 created, priority P2, status acknowledged

omar (support): Adding notes to customer threads.

jen (sre): Patching dashboards now. Will report back in this thread when panels show non-zero series. :hammer_and_wrench:

jen (sre): Patch deployed — panels in acme-inc and brightapps show restored sparklines. Monitoring for 30m.

omar (support): Customers confirmed graphs are back. Closing the support escalation once product signoff + public note ready.

maya (product): Signoff — good job. Please include a brief postmortem and add a pre-deploy checklist for label renames (alert eng-platform + devex). :memo:
